channel.title: AI Application Area Elective :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: This elective covers the use of AI within a specific application domain, i.e. the use of artificial intelligence in agriculture, biology, geography, or other discipline. These courses are drawn from the broader university pool, with the list of acceptable courses curated by the Curriculum Committee of the Department of Computer Science. Faculty or students wishing to propose the addition of courses to this list should contact Josh Weese, Undergrauduate Curriculum Director for the department with the request.
